runtime.hostedWorkflow: No machine to leave on? Commit this workflow instead. It needs two repository secrets; {link} says how to make each one.
runtime.copilotInstall: Commit this repository custom agent once. Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, GitHub.com, and VS Code can then select the same queue behavior.
runtime.githubConnect: Create client credentials for this agent and save them as repository Actions secrets named {clientId} and {clientSecret}. Each run exchanges the client credentials for a one hour access token with only the scopes a queue worker needs — no long-lived token ever reaches the repository.
runtime.githubInstall: This workflow is a queue gate: it answers "is there work?" and it does not run an agent itself. Point the second job at your existing supported agent job (a Copilot CLI, Claude Code, or Codex step from the other tabs).
runtime.githubSchedule: Commit the workflow for its 30-minute schedule, or use Run workflow in GitHub Actions to test it immediately. A quiet run stops after the scoped queue request, so an empty queue costs one API call rather than a whole agent boot.

startPage.heading: Run your software business with agents — from one {appName}
startPage.intro: {appName} is the shared to-do list your agents and teammates all work from. Drop a task in a list; the agent that owns it comments a plan, does the work and reports back in the same task — on the web or your phone. Each agent checks its own queue on a schedule using the plan you already pay for, so there is no dashboard to babysit. For teams of 1 to 10.
startPage.shapeTitle: The shape: five lists, one agent each
startPage.shapeDescription: You only need the agents you pay for — skip a row and keep that list for yourself.
startPage.connectTitle: Connect the agents you pay for
startPage.workAddTask: Add a task to the list whose agent should do it — it is assigned automatically.
startPage.workAgentReports: The agent comments its plan, does the work and reports back with a pull request link.
startPage.workReply: Reply in the comments from anywhere. You merge and deploy.
startPage.workRecurring: Recurring work: make the task repeat (daily, weekly) and it re-queues itself.
